literature_notes: The sole ledger line (L1) reports a C-terminal 1D4 epitope tag on zebrafish sws1a and sws1b, which are OPN1SW orthologs, expressed in HEK293T cells. Per the authoritative topology landmarks, the C-terminus of OPN1SW (residues 304–345) is entirely intracellular. A C-terminal tag therefore faces the cytoplasm and cannot serve as an extracellular surface tag. No ledger line reports any tag insertion at an extracellular position of OPN1SW or a close ortholog — not at the N-terminal extracellular domain (residues 1–32), nor in any of the four extracellular loops (ECL1: 91–105; ECL2: 170–196; ECL3: 268–280). Because the ledger contains no evidence grounding an extracellular insertion, zero sites are proposed. This is the correct answer, not a failure.

literature_other_positions.note: C-terminal 1D4 tag (9 aa) appended after the last residue (N345) of sws1a/sws1b OPN1SW orthologs; the C-terminus of OPN1SW lies in the intracellular domain (residues 304–345), so this tag faces the cytoplasm, not the extracellular surface.
